parsedVerdict.reasoning: TaskController is an Express HTTP adapter in the infrastructure layer. It reads values from the request, checks that required fields are present (an input-shape check, not a business rule) and passes the work to injected application use cases. It also maps the returned tasks to JSON response DTOs and turns errors into HTTP 400 responses. The if/else on status/assigneeId in listTasks only picks which use case method to call. It makes no business decision. Task state changes and assignment rules are left to the use cases, and there is no persistence code. All of these responsibilities belong to an infrastructure/transport adapter.
